questions.question: When Jacob met his cousin Rachel at a well, he rolled the large stone off the well himself to water her father's sheep. True or false?
Jacob worked seven years for Laban so he could marry Rachel. How did those years feel to Jacob?
After Jacob worked seven years to marry Rachel, Laban gave Rachel to him on the wedding night. True or false?
When Jacob protested that Laban had tricked him on the wedding night, what did Laban say was not their custom?

answers.text: Marrying off the younger daughter before the older
Holding a wedding feast for a relative from far away
Letting a groom work off the price of his bride
